meta.parties: Thambaiyar Et Al v. Paramusamy Aiyar Et Al

rules.statement: A mortgagee must sue the executor or administrator of a deceased mortgagor, and if the mortgaged property exceeds Rs. 1,000 in value, an administrator must be appointed.
rules.supporting_quote: "The proviso to section 642 enables the mortgagee to take the less onerous course of applying for the appointment of a special representative where the mortgaged property is less than Rs. 1,000 in value. The proviso no doubt says that the Court 'may' make such an appointment if it appears to the Court necessary or expedient."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 642 of the Civil Procedure Code
